column1: # Taxa reported in the watchlist table/figure of bin/results_summary.py (edit freely and pass with --watchlist).
# Columns: taxon, rank (species or genus), note (why the taxon is listed).
# Default list: the ESKAPE pathogens, the bacteria of the WHO Bacterial Priority Pathogens List 2024
# (BPPL 2024; https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240093461) and of the CDC Antibiotic Resistance
# Threats Report 2019 (https://www.cdc.gov/antimicrobial-resistance/data-research/threats/), and a few other
# species of clinical interest. Enterobacterales are listed by species or genus because the WHO and CDC entries
# name the order. Each note gives the source lists and, in brackets, the resistance they name.
# Names are matched after removing GTDB suffixes on both sides ("Enterococcus_B faecium" matches
# "Enterococcus faecium", "Enterobacter hormaechei_C" matches "Enterobacter hormaechei"), so NCBI-style names work
# for GTDB, Kraken2 and sourmash outputs alike. A genus row reports the summed abundance of the genus.
